images.prompt: A cohesive modular two-lane ten-pin bowling alley asset kit in clean low-poly stylized-realistic game art. Three-quarter view from the approach area showing both lanes with wooden board variation along their length, visible foul lines, targeting arrows, approach dots, four concave gutters, pin decks, two complete triangular ten-pin racks with white pins and red neck bands, ball return hood and rack with three colorful bowling balls, two overhead scoreboards, seating benches behind the approaches, rear masking wall with lane labels, alley floor, and decorative wall stripes. Balanced indoor lighting, readable silhouettes, polished surfaces not blown out. Original generic design without external logos.

Elevated top-down perspective layout diagram of a modular two-lane ten-pin bowling alley asset. Shows both lane surfaces side by side with gutters on all four edges, approach areas behind each lane, pin decks at the far end with triangular pin rack layouts, ball return system centered between approaches, seating area behind approaches, scoreboards overhead, rear catch pits, masking wall. Clean technical layout showing the modular arrangement, clear spacing, and functional zones. Stylized realistic game art style with labels implied by arrangement.

Close-up details of modular bowling alley game assets in stylized-realistic low-poly art. Shows individual white bowling pins with red neck bands and proper ten-pin silhouette, colorful bowling balls (blue, burgundy, green) with visible recessed finger holes, ball return rack and cradle supporting the balls, wooden lane surface with board grain variation, dark concave gutter cross-section, targeting arrows and foul line markings, overhead scoreboard with grid display and lane labels, seating bench, and decorative alley wall paneling. Balanced lighting highlighting material differences and surface details.

visual_review.observations: A wide, low-angle view of a stylized bowling alley with multiple parallel wooden lanes, white pins with red stripes, gray gutters, and a central ball return tray holding a red ball. The background shows dark seating, colorful balls, and two blue hanging screens.

A top-down, symmetrical technical view of a lane assembly showing four vertical metallic lane sections separated by light wood panels, with a central gray return mechanism and small orange components, framed by a white border and dark upper housing.

A close-up of a gray ball return tray filled with blue, red, and green bowling balls, positioned beside a low-poly pinsetter and a cluster of white pins with red rings on a light wood floor marked with dark lines and arrows.
